resources.string: Unreel watches only YouTube and Instagram. When the Shorts or Reels feed appears on screen, it takes you back to the main feed, or, if you set a time limit, once that time is used up. It reads the names of on-screen layout elements to recognise those feeds and which part of each app you are in, and times how long you spend there for Screen time; it does not read your messages, typing or video content, and nothing leaves your phone.
